method: Sources manually opened and compared; no product laboratory testing

claims.claim: Treats should not exceed 10% of calories for an average healthy adult dog
claims.limitations: Not an individualized allowance for dogs with disease or veterinary diets

claims.claim: In a vet-led elimination challenge diet, ordinary treats and flavored products can compromise the result
OTC limited ingredient products may contain undeclared protein due to cross-contamination
Novel and hydrolyzed protein diets have different use and require individualized veterinary selection
Any specific mono-eiwit treat is clinically suitable for an allergic dog
claims.action: Do not assert or recommend without veterinary/product evidence
